content:
The execution failed because modified paragraphs still contain layout cache elements. 

Error: `AssertionError: assert <Element '{...}linesegarray' ...> is None` in `test_modified_paragraphs_do_not_keep_layout_cache`.

This indicates that while the text was updated, the `<hp:linesegarray>` element (or similar layout-related tags) was not successfully removed from the modified `<hp:p>` nodes. The script must find and delete these specific child elements from any paragraph where a text replacement occurred to allow the HWP viewer to re-render the layout.
